method: Pass Shot Value (PSV): HistGradientBoostingRegressor predicting a continuous target in [0, 1] per open-play box-entry attempt -- the xG of the shot the same team takes within the next 5 events, or 0 if none. A regression companion to the xBE classifier: xBE asks 'did it arrive', PSV asks 'how much shot value did it produce'.
